verdict.rationale: Agent-readable documentation is a fair question for a developer CLI, but the evidence shows none: the llms.txt probe at developers.google.com returned HTTP 404, and no other agent-oriented docs for Gemini CLI are evidenced. GEMINI.md context files let users give the agent project context; they are not agent-readable documentation of Gemini CLI itself. The probe only checked the developers.google.com root, not the GitHub repo docs, so confidence is medium.
